description: Runnable example apps built with the cmssy headless SDK - the shapes `npx @cmssy/cli init` gets you to, with real content from the public demo workspace.
rules: Edit mode requires a VERIFIED request: cmssyEdit=1 AND a cmssySecret matching the workspace draft secret. Use the createCmssyProxy preset from @cmssy/next/middleware - never treat a bare cmssyEdit=1 as edit mode.
The editor origin is https://www.cmssy.io (cmssy cloud). app.cmssy.com does not exist.
Each block exports its field schema as `props` and the component is typed BlockProps<typeof props> - never hand-write block content types.
Locales come from the workspace (Settings -> Languages); CmssyConfig has no defaultLocale/enabledLocales.
To wire cmssy into an existing app, run: npx @cmssy/cli init && npx @cmssy/cli link.

Structured, reusable content (testimonials, FAQ items, team members) lives in workspace models and reaches a block via fields.relation - never as a fields.repeater of record-shaped items in block props. Repeaters are for view-local structure only.
A block's `loader` runs on the server during SSR only - never in the browser and never in the editor, where the component receives `data: undefined`. Keep server-only dependencies inside it.
Each example directory is standalone: its own package.json and lockfile, no root manifest, no workspace. Install and run from inside the directory.
